done_when: After an owner's accept, a later sign-off attempt reviews only files changed since the last sign-off review plus files with open findings, and does not block again on a finding the owner accepted in the same file

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - running the repository's sign-off tests.
The new reuse path makes the existing strict-review test fail. After its clean review at tests/test_proto_signoff.py:270, the test recreates the same decision without changing product files or review inputs. This condition then returns before invoking Autoreview, so the incomplete-report case returns success instead of the failure asserted at line 297. Subsequent strict-failure cases also cannot exercise the reviewer. Update their setup to invalidate review inputs before supplying each failure report, preserving coverage while allowing unchanged reviews to be reused.
findings.title: Gate: test_7_review_guards_client_signoff

why: After the owner accepts a sign-off finding with --resolve accept, the next sign-off attempt reviews the whole app again and raises the accepted finding again, so client sign-off never finishes
